setup.title: Bonus Stork
setup.text: FIND THE ROAD MARKED ON THE MAP — STAFF STORCH

plan.notes: Fictional intercept: the staff Storch (red marker) flies the valley road at tree height; two liaison flights cross his path and must not be hit. He sets down on the road when he sees you; stop the aircraft or the truck that picks up the crew.

briefLabels: Staff Storch — last seen here, heading along the road

launch.said: INTELLIGENCE — THE STAFF STORCH IS AIRBORNE ON THE ROAD MARKED ON YOUR MAP, TWO LIAISON FLIGHTS ARE ALSO UP
launch.text: STAFF STORCH — RED MARKER ON THE MAP

afterSeen.said: THE STAFF STORCH HAS SEEN YOU — HE IS SETTING DOWN ON THE ROAD, GET HIM BEFORE THE CREW REACHES A TRUCK

landing.text: STAFF CAR DRIVING OFF — STOP THE OPEL
